name: Marmalade the Town Crier Cat
blurb: Marmalade, a lean ginger tabby with rust stripes and gold eyes, meows the morning gossip from the garden gate to all who pass.

name: Soapbox the Ginger Tabby
blurb: Soapbox, a fluffy ginger tabby with a cream chin and copper eyes, stands on an old crate to lecture the sparrows at length.

name: Echo the Noticeboard Cat
blurb: Echo, a stocky ginger tabby with swirled stripes and green eyes, stamps a paw print on each note on the garden noticeboard.
